title: Lost U-Boats of WWII
description:
Lost Nazi Artifacts
Treasure hunter Darrell Miklos' search for treasure-filled, lost Nazi U-Boats takes an unexpected turn when a 98-year-old local eyewitness gives him a tip that changes the course of his entire investigation.

title: Lost U-Boats of WWII
description:
The Nazi's Secret Weapon
After finding Nazi artifacts at a sunken pier, Darrell and his team continue their search to a site known as Target 3 where they find a possible component of a Nazi secret weapon that changes the direction of their investigation.

title: Lost U-Boats of WWII
description:
Treasure Island
With weather preventing Darrell Miklos and the team from diving from the boat, they attempt a risky strategy. Garth makes a solo journey to explore a deserted island where he discovers a mysterious cross.

title: Lost U-Boats of WWII
description:
Battle Ballistics
Treasure hunter Darrell Miklos and his team make a discovery far older than they expected. Later, new evidence emerges suggesting that the team may have uncovered a long-lost battle at Target 4.

title: Lost U-Boats of WWII
description:
The Final Discovery
Racing an incoming hurricane, Darrell Miklos and his team are forced to make tough choices. But after a season-long search, they locate the source of the massive magnetometer hit recorded at Target 4.

title: Treasure
description:
Secrets of the Hope Diamond
Tale of the most famous, notorious, and perhaps most valuable gem in the world.

title: Treasure
description:
The Ancient Gold of Troy
Since WWII, one of the world's most fantastic fortunes was believed lost--its priceless heirlooms from the time of the Homeric legends a casualty of war. But when the cache was found in a secret vault in a Russian museum, an international uproar ensued over who owned the ancient treasure. Join us as we follow the journey of Troy's gold.

title: America's Book of Secrets: Special Edition
description:
Home Sweet Fortress
For some Americans, home lies not behind a picket fence, but behind steel bars, reinforced concrete, and even armed guards. What is it like to live within these residential fortresses... and what secrets are being protected within them?

title: America's Book of Secrets: Special Edition
description:
Hiding in Plain Sight
From Masonic symbols to concealed bases and hidden tunnels that exist right under our feet, are many of America's best kept secrets hiding in plain sight?

title: America's Book of Secrets: Special Edition
description:
Big Brother Is Watching
As technology advances, information about everything--and everyone--is becoming more accessible than ever before. Every action is monitored, every conversation recorded, and every secret at risk of being exposed. But in this age of unlimited access, who is collecting our information? And what are they using it for?

title: America's Book of Secrets: Special Edition
description:
A World Gone Mad
Every day, ordinary Americans are lured away from their normal lives by cults, drugs, and criminal organizations. But what causes a person to make such a radical change, even going so far as commit acts of terrorism... or take part in a mass suicide?

title: Modern Marvels
description:
Rescue Equipment
Avalanches, earthquakes, hurricanes, bombings--all mean human tragedy unless rescuers respond within a moment's notice of disaster. Here are the latest advances in rescue technology, including: a Searchcam system that locates buried victims, and the Jaws of Life that can extricate a person from a crushed car in seconds.

title: Modern Marvels
description:
Emergency Room
Emergency room medicine has only been a recognized specialty since 1989, and it took close to two millennia to get to this point. We'll examine advances that led to the modern emergency room--from the Byzantine's establishment of the first hospitals around 1050 A.D. to today's telemedicine. The prognosis for its future looks good.

title: Modern Marvels
description:
Firefighting: Containing the Demon
Fire! A blessing and curse to mankind. We'll review efforts to control this force from ancient Rome to today's thermal imaging cameras with special focus on U.S. history. We'll see how major fires in Chicago and San Francisco altered city planning, and relive the disasters at the Triangle Shirtwaist Factory and Cocoanut Grove.

title: Modern Marvels
description:
Firefighting: The Arson Detectives
Meet crime fighters who take on fiery killers. In Houston, visit the site of a suspicious fire with Fire Marshall Lalo Torres as he turns ashes into evidence. Former A.T.F. head Richard Garner explains motives behind the recent church fires. And at the California Criminalists Institute, John DeHaan trains special arson dogs.

title: Modern Marvels
description:
Firefighting: Extreme Conditions
Any fire raging out of control is a hazard, but when compounded with obstacles of extreme conditions, such as an oil well blowout or acres of forest ablaze, firefighters face new elements of danger. Meet a WWII London firefighter, "Hell Fighters" who squelch oil well infernos, and smokejumpers who parachute into forest fires.

title: Modern Marvels
description:
Dangerous Cargo
Toxic traffic is everywhere! An average of 800,000 shipments of hazardous materials hit our highways and railways daily. From Wild West wooden crates filled with explosives to HAZMAT containers of nuclear waste, we shadow dangerous cargo. We ride shotgun on a hazardous material shipment that's tracked by satellites; hunt down the hush-hush "ghost fleet"--trucks carrying classified government materials; and board a Con-Air flight moving another kind of nasty stuff--dangerous felons!

title: Modern Marvels
description:
Crashes
Explore collisions that shake our world from the astronomic to the subatomic. Discover breakthroughs that could make the deadly sport of professional auto racing safer, visit a motorcycle crash test facility, and examine two-wheeled accidents.

title: Modern Marvels
description:
Crash Testing
Delves into the little-known, hugely important, multi-billion-dollar industry of product testing--where wrinkles get ironed out and goods are stripped of marketing and hype to see if they work. Meet product testers who serve as truth squads in an eccentric world of machines devised to "sneeze" at tissue paper and "sleep" on mattresses.

title: The Bermuda Triangle: Into Cursed Waters
description:
Curse of the Carrier
The team dives in search of an A3 Skywarrior attack aircraft that was lost in a suspicious disaster off the USS Saratoga aircraft carrier in 1960.

title: The Bermuda Triangle: Into Cursed Waters
description:
The Missing Giants
Did a Bermuda Triangle tsunami claim two behemoth ships, or did they fall prey to Nazi U-Boats? The team sets its sights on a famous Bermuda Triangle case: the twin vanishings of two massive cargo ships.

title: The Bermuda Triangle: Into Cursed Waters
description:
Into the Magnetic Storm
The team seeks out the wreck of the Revonoc, a racing yacht that vanished in 1958 with a crew of five. A freak magnetic anomaly was detected in the Triangle when she went missing. Was she ripped apart by the teeth of a sudden storm?

title: The Bermuda Triangle: Into Cursed Waters
description:
Triangle of Madness
The team thinks a 300-foot wreck off the tip of Florida just might be the Sudoffco--a steel freighter lost in 1926 with 29 men while traveling through the Triangle from New Jersey to the Panama Canal.

title: The Bermuda Triangle: Into Cursed Waters
description:
The White Whale
Do new leads point the way to the biggest Bermuda Triangle mystery of all? Mike Barnette, Jimmy Gadomski, and the team of investigators are back on the trail of a famous cold case: the disappearance of seven US Navy planes in 1945.

title: The Bermuda Triangle: Into Cursed Waters
description:
Killer Queen
In the dead of night, the team heads to a remote target they believe to be the long-lost Marine Sulphur Queen. This massive tanker disappeared in 1963 with a crew of 39 and is one of the most iconic missing Bermuda Triangle wrecks.

title: The Bermuda Triangle: Into Cursed Waters
description:
Bermuda Triangle's First Blood
The team investigates a large wooden shipwreck that could be one of the Bermuda Triangle area's earliest victims: the long-lost SS D.H. Mount.

title: The Bermuda Triangle: Into Cursed Waters
description:
Pirates in the Caribbean
Are modern-day pirates prowling the Bermuda Triangle in search of victims? The team takes on the twisted case of a missing luxury boat called the Saba Bank lost in the vicinity of the Bermuda Triangle in 1974.

title: The Bermuda Triangle: Into Cursed Waters
description:
Graveyard of the Atlantic
The team has secret intel on a wreck that might be a legendary 1930s disappearance: the champion racing yacht known as Ingomar. Lured by a strange light, the Ingomar's seasoned crew smashes into an unseen obstacle. What doomed the Ingomar?

title: The Bermuda Triangle: Into Cursed Waters
description:
Falling Stars
The team zeroes in on the island of Bermuda--namesake of the Triangle--and one of the most infamous mysteries that helped establish the dark reputation of these waters.

title: The Bermuda Triangle: Into Cursed Waters
description:
Eye of the Cyclops
The team has a chance to finally solve the case of the USS Cyclops. Missing since 1918 with 309 sailors, this 500-foot freighter represents the single deadliest Bermuda Triangle loss.

title: The Bermuda Triangle: Into Cursed Waters
description:
Bermuda Triangle's Greatest Mysteries
The team unveils the greatest mysteries of the Bermuda Triangle: its most perplexing vanished ships and planes, and the strange and powerful forces said to be behind the Triangle's deadly reputation.

title: Perspectives
description:
Wendell Willkie
Never dreaming of becoming President, this is the man who blazed into national prominence and in the process nearly landed in the White House.

title: Biography
description:
Robert A. Taft
An iron-willed Republican senator who enjoyed his power, Taft was denied his greatest ambition: to follow in the footsteps of his father, President William Howard Taft.

title: Biz Kids
description:
Social Entrepreneurs
Join the Biz Kid$, and you’ll meet social visionaries who use business skills to make changes in their communities. Their focus is on people instead of profits.  Meet a 12-year old who's helping orphans in Rwanda, a teen who's donated 40,000 teddybears to kids in need, and learn how $125,000 was raised in one night by high school students for Room to Read.

title: Biz Kids
description:
Have a Plan, Stan
Explore the different elements of a business plan and see why it’s crucial to develop a plan before you start your business. Meet a teen who opened a snow-cone shack, another who makes and sells candles, and a group of hip-hop artists… all with business plans.

title: Missing: Cold Cases
description:
Missing: Cold Case 253
Profiling the cold cases of missing children; Internet safety tips; Advice for children and teens about emergency contacts and safety skills.

title: Missing: Cold Cases
description:
Missing: Cold Case 254
Profiling the cold cases of missing children; Internet safety tips; Advice for children and teens about emergency contacts and safety skills.

title: Perspectives
description:
Joseph McCarthy
The political smoke still swirls around the ideological legacy of the American senator who headed the infamous communist witch hunt trials of the 1950s.

title: Biography
description:
Dag Hammarskjold
Follow the distinguished career of the citizen-of-the-world who helped create an atmosphere of peace in his years as Secretary-General of the United Nations.

title: Biography
description:
John F. Kennedy, Jr.: The Death of an American Prince
This special look at the life and tragic death of John F. Kennedy Jr., includes a profile of his and his wife Carolyn's lives, and coverage of that shattering week in July 1999, when his plane was first reported missing.

title: Biography
description:
Caroline Kennedy
Her life shaped by the myth of Camelot, the reality of her father's assassination, and her brother's death in a plane crash, Caroline Kennedy continues to serve as a scion of her illustrious family. This profile looks at the tragedies in Caroline's life and her many achievements as well, which include two books on civil liberties, another book entitled, "Profiles in Courage for Our Time," and her domestic career as a mother of three children and wife to exhibit designer Edwin Schlossberg.
